description: Recall and dedupe evaluation set. memories is one scope's memory pool; each query lists the memories that must be recalled (relevant) and the ones that may be recalled without counting as noise (acceptable). Anything else recalled is a false positive. pairs calibrate the write-time duplicate check: duplicate pairs restate one fact, update pairs change a fact about the same subject (they must reach the conflict check but never be merged blindly), sibling pairs share a template but are different facts, unrelated pairs share nothing.
